title: Chemical Reactors
summary: Custom chemical reactor vessels with project-specific agitation, heating/cooling jackets, coils and materials.
body:
Tongyang manufactures reactor vessels for mixing and process applications based on agreed mechanical and operating requirements. Depending on the service, a package may include an agitator drive, shaft and impeller, jacket or internal coil, nozzles and selected instrumentation interfaces.

Typical applications

  • Batch mixing and blending of chemical liquids
  • Heated or cooled reaction vessel duties
  • Viscous-product handling and additive production
  • Corrosion-sensitive services requiring suitable stainless or special materials

Key technical parameters for quotation

  • Volume & medium: total/working volume, composition, viscosity, density and solids content
  • Process envelope: operating/design pressure, vacuum, temperature and batch cycle
  • Mixing: duty, impeller preference, rotational speed, motor/explosion protection requirements
  • Temperature control: jacket/coil medium, heating/cooling duty and available utilities
  • Mechanical scope: wetted material, corrosion allowance, seals, nozzles, supports, valves and controls

Manufacturing & standards

Pressure-containing reactor parts are reviewed against the agreed vessel design code, such as ASME Section VIII or GB/T 150 as applicable. Agitator sizing, hazardous-area electrical classification and safety interlocks are confirmed against the application and procurement scope.

Scope boundary: vessel fabrication and mechanical accessories do not automatically include proprietary reaction technology, process guarantees, controls or commissioning. These must be defined in the quotation.
seoDescription: Custom industrial reactor vessels and mixing equipment with options for agitation and heating or cooling.
